articles.title: A Giant Rocket Explodes! What Happens to the Moon Plan?
articles.summary: A huge Blue Origin rocket blew up during a test in Florida. No one was hurt, but it could delay NASA's plan to send a lander to the Moon this year. The same type of rocket was supposed to carry it.

articles.title: Why Are There So Few Cows in America Right Now?
articles.summary: The U.S. cattle herd is the smallest since 1951—only 86.2 million cows. Fewer cows mean higher beef prices at the store. Farmers face high costs, droughts, and a scary parasite near the border.

articles.title: Can a Reality TV Star Become Mayor of Los Angeles?
articles.summary: LA Mayor Karen Bass is running for re-election, but a huge wildfire and homelessness crisis make it tough. Her opponent is Spencer Pratt, a reality TV star from 'The Hills,' who blames her for the fire damage.
